Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native transparent PNG sprite animation atlas for an existing 2D fighting game. Image1 is the EXACT supplied masked Wolf costume identity reference; Image2 establishes its drawn right facing, Image3 its drawn left facing. Preserve this supplied appearance rather than substituting another Wolf, bare face, cloaking costume, or generic Predator. Match detailed realistic painted game-sprite linework: engraved worn silver elongated biomask with crown ridges, black dreadlocks and small gold rings, tan mottled skin and black mesh bodysuit, layered silver chest/thigh/shin/foot armor, orange-brown cloth apron and small skull neck ornament. Keep its existing shoulder-mounted cannon, pistol held in the same anatomical hand, wrist-blade gauntlet on the other arm, back spear and waist gear consistent. Six independently drawn full-body figures only. Layout EXACT portrait1024x1536 pixels, strict2columns by3rows, six512x512cells. LEFT COLUMN contains three temporal phases all facing RIGHT, RIGHT COLUMN the three corresponding phases all facing LEFT. These are newly drawn native opposing views, not horizontal flips: maintain anatomy and the same equipment ownership across the two views. Within every cell keep all figure pixels within local x70..442,y55..445, at least55pixels genuinely transparent gap to every cell boundary. Feet remain on local baseline y443 and body scale remains fixed from pose to pose. Full head, dread tips, toes, hands and weapons uncut and separate; broad transparent gutters. No lettering, watermark, grid, frames, circles, second characters, silhouettes, terrain, foot platform, cast floor shadow, motion streaks, glow aura, UI or background. Genuine RGBA alpha, fully transparent outside each figure, never a painted checkerboard or dark backdrop. Every hand/arm must have coherent anatomy and real grip; no duplicated or disconnected parts. New gameplay presentation drawings adapted from the supplied reference, no claim of source-film movement.
Family: DIZZY / vulnerable opponent awaiting finisher, NOT an attack, fatality or defeat. Draw a subtle three-pose seamless sway loop. Row1: both knees slightly bent, bowed masked head, torso tipped slightly toward opponent, pistol held safely downward. Row2: head and upper torso sway mildly back, shoulders slump, same planted feet and gear. Row3: head dips and torso returns mildly forward toward row1, coherent restrained stunned breathing. Clear small changes of mask/head, shoulder and free hand between all three rows; no stun stars, red injuries, gore, spinning weapon, rising arm or shooting. Wrist blades remain quiet at the side, shoulder cannon fixed to harness, dreadlocks attached at skull and following the small sway without intersecting chest.
